# VYNTEX

> VYNTEX (VYNTEX LLC, doing business as VYNTEX USA; New Jersey limited liability company formed June 30, 2026) is a bilingual (English/Spanish) digital technology company in Northfield, New Jersey. We connect a business's website, CRM, customer communication, scheduling, payments, AI automation, marketing and reporting into one organized system — for small and growing businesses across the United States.

VYNTEX es una empresa de tecnología digital bilingüe (inglés y español) en Northfield, New Jersey. Creamos sitios web, CRM, automatización con IA, chatbots, branding y marketing digital, todo conectado en un solo sistema para su negocio.

## Services

- [AI Automation](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/ai-automation): automated follow-up, missed-call text back, appointment reminders, workflow automation
- [AI Chatbots](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/ai-chatbots): bilingual website and messaging chatbots that answer, qualify and book
- [CRM Systems](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/crm-systems): pipelines, intake, document collection, client follow-up
- [Web Development](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/web-development): mobile-first business websites and landing pages
- [Branding](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/branding): logos, brand identity, social media design
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.vyntexusa.com/services/digital-marketing): local SEO, Google Business Profile, social media and campaigns
- Packages: start with one service or a connected website + CRM + branding package. Starter websites are ready in 7–10 business days.

## Local service area (New Jersey)

- Local office in Northfield, Atlantic County, New Jersey; in-person and online consultations; hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM
- Serves businesses within about 50 miles of Northfield: Atlantic, Cape May, Cumberland, Ocean, Gloucester, Burlington and Camden counties (including Atlantic City, Egg Harbor Township, Galloway, Hammonton, Ocean City, Wildwood, Cape May, Vineland, Millville, Bridgeton, Toms River, Long Beach Island and Glassboro), all of New Jersey, plus remote clients nationwide
- Local services: CRM systems, custom project management (CPM), ERP (VYNTEX ERP: https://erp.vyntexusa.com), AI agents, AI employees (role-based AI assistants with human handoff), AI automation, AI chatbots, websites and web development, branding, digital marketing and social media management
- New Jersey page: https://www.vyntexusa.com/new-jersey (Spanish: https://www.vyntexusa.com/es/nueva-jersey)

## Partner program

- [Authorized Reseller Program](https://www.vyntexusa.com/partners): agencies and consultants resell VYNTEX solutions under their own client relationships while VYNTEX delivers the technical work.
